title: Eigen Vault 🔐
tagline: Eigen Vault is a secure AI-powered document storage and retrieval system integrated with Telegram. It allows users to upload documents via Telegram, verify transactions using EigenLayer AVS, and retrieve stored documents on demand.
description:
Eigen Vault is an AI-powered document storage and verification system that leverages Telegram, EigenLayer AVS, and blockchain security to provide tamper-proof document handling. Users can securely upload, tag, and retrieve documents via Telegram, while every storage action is cryptographically verified and recorded using EigenLayer AVS. The project itself is securely stored in an on-chain repository using OpSec, ensuring trustless, verifiable, and censorship-resistant code integrity.

Use Case🌍
In an era where digital documentation is crucial for identity verification, compliance, and record-keeping, traditional cloud storage solutions come with risks like data breaches, unauthorized access, and centralized control. Eigen Vault solves these issues by combining:
✅ AI-driven document management for easy tagging and retrieval.
✅ Decentralized verification using EigenLayer AVS, ensuring document authenticity.
✅ On-chain integrity with OpSec-secured storage, guaranteeing that the system itself remains verifiable and tamper-proof.
✅ Secure Telegram integration, enabling users to interact with the system effortlessly.

Real-World Applications 📌
    KYC & Identity Verification → Securely store and retrieve ID proofs.
    Financial Record Management → Safely archive tax documents, ITRs, and invoices.
    Legal & Compliance Storage → Maintain contracts and agreements with immutable proofs.
how_its_made:
Eigen Vault is built using Eliza, an AI agent powered by OpenRouter, and Telegram client integration to facilitate secure document handling. It combines local document storage, blockchain verification using EigenLayer AVS, and on-chain repository hosting via OpSec to ensure authenticity and security.

    AI Processing: Uses Eliza to interact with user and telegram client.
    Telegram Client: Handles user request for uploading, retrieving, and verifying documents.
    Local Storage: Documents are currently stored locally, with future plans to upload them on-chain using Lit Protocol.
    EigenLayer AVS: Verifies that documents are generated by a human and ensures retrieval is done by the AI agent.
    OpSec On-Chain Hosting: The project repository is stored on-chain using OpSec for immutability and verifiability.
